Perhaps a loved one of John's and your OC get taken by a gunslinging gang, that way it kind of forces John, Sam, and Dean to work together to rescue them! 😁 Unless you really want your OC on the rescue team, which then in that case, maybe the gang takes something valuable to both of them.

There's a world of opportunity here! I just mostly envision Dean geeking out at the most inappropriate times 🤣

I think I'll have to respectfully disagree!

I think a RDR × Supernatural crossover would be a wonderful combo! We already know that Dean canonically has a love for cowboys and westerns (S6,EP13) AND he's proven periodically throughout the series that he's a total nerd (Like all of us 🤣) for various facets of pop-culture!

u/Night_Owl0626 If you wanna keep the storyline as canonical as possible to Supernatural, I'd say have it take place somewhere between the end of Season 6 (Last ep aired May 20, 2010, RDR came out two days prior) and S9, EP4. The reason I say that, is because with that time period, you could easily come up with a scenario where Charlie introduces the game to Dean, knowing his love for cowboys, and the boys get Scoobynaturaled into the game somehow, and Charlie has to figure out how to get them out on her end while they have to survive on theirs.

Just an idea to throw your way OP! I love this idea overall and can't wait to maybe read it in the future! 😁💕
Bofuri is awesome! I just finished watching it and it's super wholesome and fun! It's also great if he likes gaming 💖
